raw.excerpt: About UsCircle is building the world’s leading all-in-one platform for online communities.
raw.description:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading all-in-one platform for online communities. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 200 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Email Hub to own messaging, positioning, and go-to-market for one of Circle’s most powerful and fast-growing product surfaces.

Email is at the heart of how creators build durable, owned relationships with their audience — and Circle customers already send millions of emails every month through our platform. From newsletters and product announcements to lifecycle automation and event reminders, Email Hub plays a critical role in helping community businesses grow and monetize.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with our Head of Email Hub to bring new features and improvements to market, shaping how we tell the story of email inside a community-first platform. You’ll report to the Head of Product Marketing and work cross-functionally with Product, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to drive adoption, differentiation, and long-term value.

A fun fact: creators consistently see higher open rates, click-throughs, and revenue per subscriber when email is paired with community. Your job is to help the world understand why Circle is uniquely positioned to power the next era of creator-led email.

What you'll be doing

Own messaging and positioning for Circle’s Email Hub surface area.Develop and evolve clear, differentiated messaging that explains how Circle enables creators and community businesses to build owned relationships, drive engagement, and grow sustainably through email.

Craft high-impact copy and product content.Write, edit, and oversee the creation of Email Hub–related product content across the website, lifecycle emails, launch assets, sales decks, and product collateral. Your focus will be on translating complex email functionality — automation, segmentation, deliverability, and analytics — into clear, compelling customer value.

Guide go-to-market strategy for Email Hub features and improvements.Partner with Product, Growth, and Engineering to plan and execute launches for new Email Hub capabilities, optimizations, and experiments. Ensure launches are tightly coordinated, adoption-focused, and measured against meaningful engagement and retention outcomes.

Enable the go-to-market team.Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to create sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, FAQs, battlecards, demos, and internal training that help teams confidently sell and support Circle’s Email Hub.

Develop customer-facing enablement and education.Create external resources including product guides, FAQs, help content, onboarding flows, and best-practice examples that help customers understand and fully leverage Email Hub to grow and engage their communities.

Collaborate cross-functionally to drive insight-led messaging.Partner with Product, Growth, Customer Success, and Data teams to gather customer insights, feedback, and performance data. Use these insights to continuously refine messaging, positioning, and launch strategies for Email Hub.

Support Circle’s broader product marketing strategy.Contribute to Circle’s overall messaging and positioning framework by ensuring Email Hub narratives are consistent, differentiated, and aligned with Circle’s community-first product vision and brand.

What you'll need to be successful

  • Strong alignment with our values. Find our values on our career page if you haven’t read up on them yet.
  • You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C1 / ILR Level 5.
  • 5+ years of product marketing experience, preferably within a high-growth, software company environment, with a strong emphasis on messaging, positioning, and copywriting.
  • A commitment to excellence and craft. We sweat the small details. We obsess over copy, clarity, and consistency. We hold a high bar for how our product and brand show up in the world, and we expect you to do the same.
  • Exceptional written communication skills. You are an excellent writer and editor. In a fully remote, async company, writing is one of your most important tools.
  • Proven ability to create high-impact messaging that resonates with diverse audiences and drives real outcomes, from product adoption to revenue growth.
  • Strong storytelling and simplification skills. You’re able to take complex product surfaces and translate them into clear, compelling narratives that customers immediately understand and value.
  • Experience crafting positioning frameworks and leading go-to-market strategies for new product launches, working cross-functionally from strategy through execution.
  • A deep understanding of customer personas and pain points, and a demonstrated ability to address them through thoughtful, customer-first messaging.
  • A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility end-to-end, from defining the problem to shipping the solution and measuring impact. You don’t wait to be told what to do, and you care deeply about the outcomes of your work.
  • A track record of effective cross-functional collaboration with Product, Growth, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver successful launches and campaigns.
  • A strong work ethic and comfort with high expectations. We’re a fast-growing, venture-backed company with ambitious plans. This role is high-impact and high-accountability, and it’s best suited for someone who thrives in that environment.

Bonus Points

  • You’re a growth marketer turned PMM (or have spent meaningful time in growth), and naturally think about messaging in, funnels, experimentation, and how positioning decisions drive real adoption, activation, and revenue impact.
  • You’ve worked on email or lifecycle products and know how to bring campaigns, automations, and engagement workflows to market with clarity, deliverability awareness, and a focus on real audience growth.

$140,000 - $160,000 USD per year

The cash compensation range shown is a starting point. In addition to equity, benefits and perks, your cash compensation is subject to an annual review and increase on a once per year basis.

The fun stuff

  • Fully remote: work from anywhere in the world!
  • Autonomy and trust to do your job: we care about outcomes over everything else.
  • Paid time away: all employees are given 35 days of PTO annually. We also offer a paid sabbatical after 5 years.
  • Generous U.S. benchmarked compensation and startup equity no matter where you are in the world.*
  • Awesome medical coverage with 100% coverage for you and your family, or medical reimbursement options where applicable!*
  • Parental leave for parents expanding their family, or just starting one.
  • Home office stipend to help you get up and running.
  • Learning & development stipend to help you level up your professional skills.
  • Annual bonus potential for roles that don't already receive variable income or commission.
  • Company retreats: Twice a year, the Circle team gets together for a fully paid company retreat in incredible places around the world! We’ve had past retreats in Colombia, Portugal, and Mexico, with more planned on the horizon.
  • Check out our Careers page for more.

*Your role, location and unique circumstance may affect this.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

As a fully-remote international company, diversity is baked into our DNA. Here’s how our CEO, Sid Yadav, frames our hiring mission: “let’s find talent in underserved and under-represented corners of the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, change their life.” To achieve this hiring mission, we offer competitive U.S. benchmarked compensation no matter where someone’s located in the world, and we proactively seek candidates who expand representation of backgrounds, cultures and lived experiences in our teams.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Circle is an equal opportunity employer and as such, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

How We Use Candidate Data

At Circle, we are committed to protecting your personal information. As a job applicant, the personal data you provide to us is collected and processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in the EU and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). This notice outlines the types of personal information we collect, the purpose for collecting it, and your rights.

Information We Collect: We collect the following categories of personal information from job applicants:

  • Contact information (such as name, email address, phone number)
  • Employment history and qualifications
  • Education history
  • References and any other information you choose to share with us during the application process

Purpose of Collection: We collect this information for the following purposes:

  • To assess your qualifications and suitability for the position
  • To communicate with you during the recruitment process
  • To comply with legal and regulatory obligations

Your Rights Under GDPR and CCPA: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • The right to request access to the personal information we hold about you.
  • The right to request the deletion of your personal information, subject to certain legal exceptions.
  • The right to opt out of the sale of your personal information (Note: We do not sell personal information).

For more information about how we handle your personal data or to exercise your rights, please refer to our full Privacy Policy.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice.

raw.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care through the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We replace the outdated, error-prone paper and fax process, which negatively impacts over 30 million patients annually, with a system that’s 10 times faster. Our platform connects a vast network of Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers, clinicians, and payors across all 50 states, ensuring millions of patients get the life-saving products they need quickly and efficiently.
Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Health System Accounts owns the end to end relationship with health system owners using Parachute Health. This role sits within the Clinical Enterprise Account Management organization and partners closely with Enterprise Health System Account Managers to ensure alignment across clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders.

This role is accountable for driving order growth, operational performance, and adoption of Parachute workflows while maintaining a strong understanding of health system structures, clinical operations, and technology integrations.This is a strategic, data driven account management role.

Responsibilities

Account Ownership and Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary Account Manager for assigned health system owned HME providers where the hospital counterpart is also on Parachute
  • Work closely with the Health System Account Manager to create a symbiotic
  • Own executive and operational relationships across HME leadership, intake, billing, and operations
  • Navigate health system governance, reporting structures, and decision making hierarchies
  • Lead QBRs, success planning, and performance reviews
  • Act as the escalation point for HME related workflow, performance, and adoption issues

Performance Management and Data Driven Solutioning

  • Own and report on key performance metrics including order volume, fulfillment rate, response time, and sendback trends
  • Use Parachute data to identify leakage, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities
  • Translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations for HME and health system stakeholders
  • Partner cross functionally to drive measurable improvements

Technology and Integration Fluency

  • Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of HME ERP systems such as Brightree and similar platforms
  • Understand how Parachute integrates with HME ERPs to support order intake, fulfillment, and billing workflows
  • Maintain a high level understanding of Parachute’s EHR integrations, most commonly Epic and Cerner
  • Confidently speak to how clinical orders flow from the EHR into Parachute and downstream into HME systems
  • Partner with Implementation, Product, and Integration teams to support optimization and troubleshooting
  • This role is not responsible for building integrations, but must be able to strategically problem solve and communicate across systems.

Growth and Expansion

  • Drive increased order capture into health system owned HME providers
  • Expand Parachute adoption across HME workflows and facilities
  • Support new owned HME launches, expansions, and migrations from fax or legacy processes

raw.excerpt: OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure.
raw.description:
OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfill its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Requirements

This vital life cycle management position is US-based (Wisconsin preferred) focused solely on the US market. The Outsourced Operations Leader will manage and develop the relationship with a US-based CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) specifically for the manufacture and continuity of supply of the OrganOx metra® system.

This role may also support the evaluation and development of a second source for the perfusion kit used in the American market.

You will be responsible and accountable for ensuring continuity of supply, supporting local supplier development and risk management, through the development and deployment of improved supplier performance specific to the US market, and definition of supply chain strategies,

Be a change agent

Empowered with the freedom to drive change within the supplier base and expand scope.

Major Responsibilities

Reporting to the Outsourced Operation Manager, the Outsourced Operations Leader will be responsible and accountable for the following:

· Act as the primary point of contact for all CDMO-related activities and issues within the United States.

· Develop and maintain effective relationships with local US suppliers to foster collaboration and trust.

· Be responsible for strategy input and execution for suppliers supporting the American market only.

· Deliver key category performance indicators, including savings, risk mitigation, and quality assurance within the US supply base.

· Supplier selection, onboarding, lifecycle management, and potential management of phase-out specific to the US market, rationalise supplier base,

· Reorganize supply chain.

· Redefine supplier strategy

· Collaborates with suppliers, regulatory and quality team to implement and monitor quality assurance protocols specific to medical devices, ensuring adherence to industry best practices and regulatory requirements.

· Adhere to the letter and spirit of OrganOx’s Code of Conduct and all other company policies

· End to end supply chain management of key suppliers including business reviews to manage KPI's

Technical –

  • Develop and deploy structured Category Management processes and define supplier management strategies
  • Assesses impact and refines category plans to support business requirements.
  • Document processes and procedures related to supplier development

· Engages and supports procurement and quality teams to qualify key suppliers & migrate spend from incumbent, poor performance suppliers.

  • Develop and deploy supplier performance metrics, to drive continuous improvement and ensure continuity of supply, analyses category supplier performance data to find opportunities for supplier performance improvement establishing continuous improvement goals and deploying adequate projects or activities
  • Aligned with the category strategy, collaborate with the Procurement to negotiate supply agreements
  • Coordinate Supplier Change control to ensure that any changes in the supply chain do not compromise the quality or compliance of medical devices.
  • Manage the OrganOx cross function team to ensure all activities and projects are executed and prioritized to maintain supply continuity

· Coordinates with regulatory affairs to ensure all supplier-related documentation meets the necessary regulatory requirements for medical devices.

Leadership

· Influences cross-functional colleagues (quality, engineering, operations, finance, etc.) to ensure category strategies and activities are aligned with key driver goals, business priorities and financial imperatives

· Works with supplier and leads cross-functional internal teams to advance key business drivers such as supply continuity, quality, cost and operational performance

· Develop supplier strategic partnerships and secures capacity with suppliers (asset management, unconstraint capacity…)

· Collaborates with cross-functional colleagues to unable and support suppliers’ performance.

· Enable team to develop predictive analytics

· Acts as a coach/mentor to colleagues on category strategy process

· Based on business requirements, forecast the category team resources allocation, and animate hiring process.

· Drive stakeholder response to expediate key supplier issues, and drive resolution.

Skills & Experience

· 5+ years of experience in supply chain management, supplier development, procurement, or manufacturing within regulated industry required.

· Proven experience in establishing and managing supplier agreements, contracts, and logistics arrangements

· Strong understanding of medical device manufacturing standards (GMP, ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820, EU MDR) preferred.

· Experience in supplier risk management, escalation handling, and performance tracking required.

· Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive collaboration between Procurement, Supply Chain, and Quality preferred.

· Strong problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to supply chain continuity required.

· Good communication skills, including strong written, verbal and data summation abilities.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a supply chain, operations, manufacturing or related field required.

· Master’s degree preferred.

Head of User Acquisition

Role Overview

We’re looking for a senior leader to take full ownership of top‑of‑funnel user acquisition across all marketing‑driven channels. This role combines strategic planning with hands‑on performance management, ensuring that acquisition efforts are scalable, efficient, and aligned with broader business goals.

You’ll be responsible for acquisition outcomes, budget oversight, and team leadership. While you’ll collaborate closely with Product, Growth, and Data teams, this position focuses specifically on acquisition rather than the full growth lifecycle (retention, monetization, or product‑led growth).

Key Responsibilities

User Acquisition Leadership

  • Own user acquisition performance across all channels, including forecasting, reporting, and continuous optimization.

  • Manage acquisition efforts across:

    • Paid channels (search, social, video, emerging platforms)

    • Organic channels (SEO, ASO, platform visibility, LLM‑driven discovery)

    • Owned social surfaces (YouTube, TikTok, and future platforms)

    • Influencer, creator, and affiliate programs

    • Partnerships and distribution channels (in collaboration with the Partnerships team)

  • Ensure each channel has clear goals, ownership, and performance expectations.

Strategy & Execution

  • Translate company and marketing strategy into actionable acquisition plans with defined priorities, targets, and expected outcomes.

  • Build short‑ and mid‑term acquisition roadmaps aligned with growth objectives.

  • Maintain forecasting models to guide planning and investment decisions.

Performance Management

  • Define and maintain acquisition KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences.

  • Conduct regular performance reviews, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.

Budget Ownership

  • Manage or influence the user acquisition budget, ensuring efficient allocation across channels.

  • Optimize spend to balance scale, ROI, and sustainable growth.

  • Recommend budget adjustments based on performance and strategic needs.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and grow a User Acquisition team (initially 2–3 direct reports, with potential to scale).

  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and operating rhythms.

  • Create an environment that supports high performance and accountability.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:

    • Marketing leadership to align acquisition with overall strategy

    • Product and Growth teams on product‑led acquisition surfaces (without owning PLG metrics)

    • Data teams on attribution, experimentation, and analytics

  • Collaborate with senior individual contributors across the funnel to ensure clarity of scope and expectations.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in user acquisition, growth, or performance marketing for B2C software products.

  • Proven track record scaling consumer products with large user bases (desktop and/or mobile).

  • Strong hands‑on experience managing acquisition targets, budgets, and forecasting.

  • Ability to operate at a senior management level, translating strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading and scaling teams, with clear goal‑setting and accountability frameworks.

  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity with attribution models and experimentation.

  • Excellent communication and cross‑functional collaboration abilities.

  • Fluent English (B2+).

  • Based in Europe (remote‑friendly).

Nice to Have

  • Experience in gaming, creator tools, or products aimed at Gen Z / Gen Alpha.

  • Deep understanding of YouTube and TikTok as discovery/search platforms.

  • Experience scaling acquisition across multiple regions.

  • Background in freemium or self‑serve business models.

  • Experience working with product teams on product‑led acquisition.

  • Exposure to scaling‑stage environments where processes and teams were built or restructured.

Job Title: PCP Referral & Insurance Data Coordinator

Classification: 1099 Contractor

Work Structure: Fully Remote

Schedule/Shift: 25-40 hours per week, flexible schedule

Team: Clinical Operations

Location: United States

Compensation: $16-$18 per hour

About the Role

This role owns the end-to-end execution of our Primary Care Provider (PCP) referral process. A PCP referral is a document we fax to a patient’s primary care office to obtain approval for our

services. This person is responsible for ensuring those referrals are created accurately, sent to the right place, and followed up on until we’ve received a response.

This is an operational, detail-oriented role that sits at the intersection of patient coordination and provider communication. It’s well-suited for someone with healthcare office experience who is

comfortable working across systems, communicating by phone, and keeping complex workflows moving.

This role is critical to moving patients into care. Success looks like accurate referrals, persistent follow-up, clean data, and timely responses from PCP offices.

Responsibilities

  • Generate PCP referral PDFs using information from our internal systems
  • Research and locate the correct PCP office, contact details, and fax number
  • Send referrals via fax and confirm receipt with the PCP office by phone
  • Maintain a consistent follow-up cadence with offices that have not responded
  • Reach out to patients to ask them to notify their PCP to expect the referral
  • Track referral status and outcomes in our system with accuracy and consistency
  • Flag issues, delays, or systemic blockers in the referral process
  • Support broader operational data-entry and cleanup tasks beyond PCP referrals to help keep our systems accurate and up to date

Requirements

  • Prior experience in a healthcare office environment (front desk, referrals, insurance, or similar)
  • Familiarity with insurance or healthcare workflows
  • Comfortable making frequent outbound phone calls to provider offices and patients
  • Extremely detail-oriented and organized, with strong follow-through
  • Very comfortable using technology and learning new tools and processes quickly
  • Able to navigate multiple systems at once (internal tools, spreadsheets, fax tools, EHR portals, etc.)
  • Clear, professional communication skills (phone and written)
  • Reliable, self-directed, and able to manage work independently over time

*Note this is a 1099 contractor position

raw.description:
About the role

As an ​​International Student Advisor at Passage, you will help expand our reach by engaging directly with prospective students across global markets. You will guide students from first inquiry through application, ensuring they understand program options, study pathways, financing opportunities, and visa processes. This role is ideal for someone with experience in international education advising, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for helping students navigate life-changing decisions.

Who we are

Our mission is bold but simple: by 2030, we aim to dismantle the barriers preventing brilliant minds from accessing the opportunities they deserve. Starting with financial barriers, we provide loans to international students and refugees so they can pursue higher education in Canada and unlock a world of possibilities.

Who you are

Mission-driven: You believe in the power of education to transform lives.
Student-centric: You listen deeply, advocate for students, and guide them confidently through complex processes.
Results-oriented: You work toward clear metrics and deliver consistent outcomes.
Industry-savvy: You understand Canadian programs, admissions timelines, visa requirements, and recruitment trends.
Operationally strong: You stay organized, follow through on every lead, and ensure nothing slips between the cracks.

What you will do

Student recruitment and advising

  • Engage with prospective students through calls, messages, events, and webinars

  • Conduct detailed advising sessions on program options, eligibility, pathways, and admissions processes

  • Guide students through application steps, required documents, deadlines, and next-step decisions

  • Maintain a deep understanding of Passage’s programs, financing products, and admissions standards

  • Ensure students understand study permit processes and best practices for visa success

Pipeline and performance management

  • Own and deliver on monthly and weekly recruitment and conversion targets

  • Track every lead and application through Passage’s CRM with accuracy and discipline

  • Identify bottlenecks and proactively move students toward submission and enrollment

  • Analyze conversion data to improve workflows and student guidance

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Partner closely with the admissions team to ensure clean, complete applications

  • Work with marketing on localized campaigns, webinars, and student events

What you bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in international student recruitment, advising, or counseling

  • Strong knowledge of Canadian admissions, program pathways, and visa processes

  • Proven success in meeting or exceeding recruitment or conversion targets

Skills

  • Outstanding communication and student engagement abilities

  • Strong advising, problem-solving, and expectation-setting skills

  • Experience working in CRMs and managing high-volume pipelines

  • Organized, reliable, and detail-focused

  • Ability to work across time zones and cultural contexts

Why join Passage

At Passage, we’re redefining global student mobility by combining financing, admissions, and career success into one seamless experience. You will join a fast-growing, mission-driven team that’s helping students access opportunities that change lives.

Professional Services Engineer (PSE) odpowiada za wsparcie techniczne i doradcze w zakresie wdrażania, testowania i certyfikacji produktów Storware. Osoba na tym stanowisku współpracuje zarówno z klientami końcowymi, jak i partnerami biznesowymi, realizując zadania związane z instalacją, konfiguracją, prezentacjami, szkoleniami oraz promocją produktów. PSE działa na styku technologii i biznesu, dbając o sprawną implementację rozwiązań, wysoką jakość usług oraz budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami i partnerami.

  • >Zakres obowiązków:

1. Wsparcie techniczne i wdrożeniowe

  • Wsparcie instalacji i konfiguracji produktów Storware u klientów.
  • Udział w realizacji wdrożeń w środowiskach testowych i produkcyjnych.
  • Pomoc w testach funkcjonalnych i migracjach danych.
  • Rozwiązywanie podstawowych problemów technicznych przy wsparciu zespołu inżynierskiego.

2. Współpraca z klientami i partnerami

  • Udział w prezentacjach produktów i demonstracjach (we wsparciu PSE).
  • Pomoc organizacji i realizacji szkoleń technicznych dla klientów i partnerów.
  • Obsługa zapytań technicznych i wdrożeniowych pierwszej linii.
  • Wsparcie procesów certyfikacyjnych partnerów.

3. Wsparcie kanału partnerskiego

  • Utrzymywanie bieżącego kontaktu z partnerami.
  • Pomoc w realizacji wdrożeń u partnerów.
  • Monitorowanie jakości realizowanych projektów partnerskich.
  • Wsparcie działań promujących produkty Storware.

4. Dokumentacja i procesy

  • Tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji wdrożeniowej oraz instrukcji.
  • Uzupełnianie bazy wiedzy i materiałów szkoleniowych.
  • Raportowanie realizowanych działań projektowych.
  • Współpraca z zespołami PSE, R&D i Product Management.

5. Reprezentowanie firmy

  • Profesjonalna komunikacja z klientami i partnerami.
  • Wspieranie pozytywnego wizerunku Storware podczas wdrożeń i szkoleń.
  • Dbałość o jakość obsługi oraz standardy firmy.

Kwalifikacje:

Kompetencje techniczne

  • Podstawowe doświadczenie w instalacji i konfiguracji oprogramowania.
  • Ogólna znajomość środowisk IT (serwery, storage, wirtualizacja, chmura).
  • Umiejętność realizacji testów oraz wsparcia wdrożeń zgodnie z dokumentacją.
  • Podstawowa znajomość procesów wdrożeniowych i partnerskich.

Mile widziane: podstawowa znajomość technologii backupowych oraz skryptów (Bash, PowerShell).

Kompetencje miękkie

  • Dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne.
  • Chęć nauki i rozwijania kompetencji technicznych.
  • Umiejętność pracy z klientem oraz partnerem.
  • Dobra organizacja pracy własnej.
  • Umiejętność pracy zespołowej i dzielenia się wiedzą.
  • Znajomość języka angielskiego min. B1/B2.

CO OFERUJEMY

💻sprzęt i narzędzia pracy spełniające wysokie standardy bezpieczeństwa danych (wdrożone ISO 27001),

💻dużą autonomię w planowaniu i realizacji działań

💻realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju produktu oraz kształtowanie procesów biznesowych,

💻przejrzystą i otwartą ścieżkę rozwoju w kierunku ról seniorskich i menedżerskich,

💻jasno określone, realistyczne i mierzalne cele,

💻współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem technologicznym stanowiącym solidne zaplecze merytoryczne,

💻elastyczny model pracy — zdalny, hybrydowy, biurowy lub wyjazdowy, w zależności od preferowanego stylu działania.

JAK WYGLĄDA PROCES REKRUTACJI

  1. Analiza aplikacji.

  2. Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna dotycząca doświadczenia zawodowego i oczekiwań (ok. 10 minut).

  3. Spotkanie online lub w biurze w Warszawie z osobą z obszaru HR oraz osobą odpowiedzialną za zespół.

  4. Przekazanie informacji zwrotnej po zakończeniu etapu rozmów.

  5. Ustalenie warunków współpracy i podpisanie umowy przedwstępnej.

  6. Rozpoczęcie współpracy i wdrożenie do zespołu.

INFORMACJE FORMALNE

Administratorem danych osobowych jest Storware sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie (ul. Bakalarska 15A U2, 02-212 Warszawa). Dane osobowe są przetwarzane w celu realizacji procesu rekrutacji, zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami RODO. Szczegółowe informacje dotyczące przetwarzania danych dostępne są w polityce prywatności.

O NAS

W Storware tworzymy oprogramowanie do tworzenia kopii zapasowych i odzyskiwania danych dla nowoczesnych infrastruktur — OpenStack, VMware OpenShift i innych środowisk wirtualnych. Opracowywane rozwiązania pomagają ograniczać ryzyko utraty danych oraz związane z tym koszty i są wdrażane w organizacjach na całym świecie. Działania opierają się na innowacyjności, wysokiej jakości technologicznej oraz współpracy zespołowej. Dystans, ciekawość i odrobina kosmicznej perspektywy są zawsze u nas mile widziane.

Overview:
The Solution Consultant – Identity & Security partners with Sales to help customers address complex identity, access, and security challenges. This role reports to the Solution Consulting Manager within the Identity & Security team and serves as a trusted technical and business advisor, translating requirements into differentiated, outcome-driven solutions that reduce risk, improve governance, and enable secure business operations. The ideal candidate combines deep domain knowledge in identity and security with a consultative mindset and can communicate effectively with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders. This is a fast-paced, growth-stage team that values ownership, initiative, and adaptability. SCs who thrive with autonomy and are energized by building something new will be well positioned to succeed.

This role sits at the forefront of building ServiceNow’s Identity & Security GTM, offering Solution Consultants the opportunity to drive impact, establish best practices, and help define what “great” looks like as the business scales.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Engagement & Solution Design:
    Partner with Sales to lead discovery, solution design, and technical validation for Identity & Security use cases. Engage with customer security, identity, IT, and risk stakeholders to understand requirements, challenges, and success criteria. Design and position solutions that address identity governance, access control, risk reduction, and security automation.
  • Demonstrations & Technical Leadership:
    Deliver compelling, value-based demonstrations tailored to customer security and identity priorities. Articulate how identity and security capabilities integrate into broader enterprise workflows and platforms. Serve as a technical authority during evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and competitive situations.
  • Value & Outcome Positioning:
    Translate identity and security capabilities into business outcomes such as reduced risk, improved compliance, and operational efficiency. Support executive-level conversations by framing security and identity initiatives in terms of business impact and resilience. Partner with Sales to develop solution narratives that align to customer priorities and buying personas.
  • Deal Support & Execution:
    Support complex sales cycles from early discovery through close, ensuring technical accuracy and customer alignment. Identify and mitigate technical or solution-related risks during the sales process. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned to product capabilities.
  • Continuous Learning & Collaboration:
    Stay current on identity, security, and regulatory trends to inform customer conversations. Share field insights and best practices with peers and leadership. Partner with Product, Enablement, and Marketing teams to provide feedback from the field. Participate in a sales-driven, high-accountability culture centered on continuous skill development in a rapidly evolving security market.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales, or a related technical role
  • Track record of strong performance in prior SC roles — expect to demonstrate consistent contribution to technical wins and deal outcomes.
  • Genuinely curious and proactive in adopting AI and emerging sales support technologies to enhance customer engagements, solution design, and deal execution.
  • Strong understanding of identity and security concepts, including identity governance, access management, and risk
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, demonstrate their capabilities, and connect them to impactful customer business challenges.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-level complex sales cycles
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills — able to paint the art of the possible and align solutions to customer priorities.
  • Willingness to travel as required (typically 25–50%)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), or Security Operations platforms
  • Background in enterprise SaaS or platform-based solutions
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory considerations impacting identity and security programs

What Success Looks Like:

  • Become productive quickly and add immediate value to active pursuits
  • Deliver high-quality POCs and demos that advance pipeline and build customer confidence
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with Sales partners and customers through technical expertise
  • Demonstrate strong technical credibility and consistent execution across opportunities
  • Contribute to measurable improvement in win rates and deal quality

raw.title: Associate Director of Major Gifts
raw.excerpt: About the role: Reporting to the Director of Major Gifts, the Associate Director of Major Gifts is responsible for creating and implementing strategies to retain existing major gift donors, upgrade their giving, and bringing in new prospects to Indivisible.
raw.description:
About the role:

Reporting to the Director of Major Gifts, the Associate Director of Major Gifts is responsible for creating and implementing strategies to retain existing major gift donors, upgrade their giving, and bringing in new prospects to Indivisible.

To be successful in this role, the Associate Director of Major Gifts is expected to be proactive, a strong writer, communicate effectively and have strong collaborative skills, and have a sharp eye for detail. They should have a keen interest in helping to resource the Indivisible movement. The main duties of this position include being responsible for solicitations, upgrades, and renewals for a segment of the major gift portfolio, leading strategy on donor engagement events, owning a share of donor communications and pitches for our work, leading major gifts projects and campaigns, managing our major gifts prospecting strategy, and supporting cross-team efforts.

We are hiring for this position immediately. This position is full-time, with a salary of $110,000 per year, commensurate with experience. To uphold organizational parity and pay equity, we use a non-negotiable salary system that takes into consideration the entire breadth of a candidate’s experience, employment, and education to arrive at their final starting base salary. In addition, Indivisible provides a robust benefits package including full medical/dental/vision/life coverage, a professional development stipend, and an employer-matched 401(k) plan.

To be considered, please submit your cover letter and resume. Please be sure to include insight into major donor fundraising specifics, including gift and portfolio size, or any other metrics you wish to share. Note: Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be considered.

What you'll do:

Major Gift Renewals & Stewardship (40%)
  • Responsible for securing renewals and upgrades from a segment of our portfolio of major donors.
  • Develop and implement personalized cultivation and stewardship strategies for the segment of donors in your portfolio, including regular meetings, communication, events, and other engagement activities throughout the year.
  • Design & implement tailored cultivation plans for assigned segment of the major donor portfolio, ensuring renewals, upgrades, and thoughtful stewardship.
  • Own grant proposals and reporting for a segment of our major donor portfolio.
Pitch and Strategy Development (35%)
  • Lead the development of 4-5 major gifts projects/campaigns over the year. This may include owning a campaign on a major scope of work for Indivisible, virtual events and briefings or new initiatives that this position develops
  • Own travel and events strategy and planning for donor cultivation and stewardship in target markets.
  • Own a healthy share of MG communications – developing compelling pitches, case statements, and donor facing materials tailored to individuals’ interests.
  • Lead writing and submission of grant reports, proposals, and other required written materials for a segment of major donors.
Donor Prospecting (20%)
  • Lead major gifts prospecting work in collaboration with the internal team and our external consultants to identify, research, qualify, and help Indivisible’s leadership build relationships with new major gift donors and current donors who have the capacity to upgrade their gifts.
  • Drive creative prospecting tactics to research, qualify, and engage new major donor prospects to expand Indivisible’s donor network.
  • Strengthen our relationship with donor advisors and donor communities we know, including by managing up to Indivisible's leadership to ensure they are in frequent communication and by preparing outreach for them to send.
  • Help to identify new donor advisors and donor communities, and create strategies for building connections
Other Development Team Responsibilities (5%)
  • Help in other cross-team development efforts by supporting team projects over the course of the year.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • At least 7 years relevant experience in fundraising, with at least 4 years experience cultivating and soliciting 4 and 5-figure gifts from individuals.
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to craft concise, persuasive pitches.
  • Previous experience fundraising in a fast-paced environment -- this could be in the non-profit or campaign space.
  • Experience in planning and executing successful fundraising events, campaigns, and tactics
  • At least one cycle of campaign experience.
  • Excellent organizational skills with high attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to think proactively and prioritize work.
  • Strong communication skills (via phone, email, and video chat), both with colleagues and donors.
  • Experience exercising discretion and confidentiality with sensitive information.
  • Ability to manage up to senior-level staff with confidence and good judgment.
  • Alignment on the core values and strategy of Indivisible.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar donor database.
  • Experience writing and submitting formal grant reports and proposals.
  • Experience working across entities – 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), and PAC.

About Indivisible Project

We’re building something new. We’re a progressive grassroots organization that began in the aftermath of Trump’s election. We’re working to build a democracy that reflects a broad, multiracial “we the people,” one that works for all of us and is sustained by all of us. To support this movement, we’ve built an incredible team at the national level. We dream big, we support each other, and we have fun doing it. For more information about Indivisible’s vision, mission, and theory of change, click here.

We’re changing what’s politically possible. Indivisible is part of the powerful progressive movement reaction to Trump, fighting the racist, misogynistic, plutocratic, and authoritarian agenda trumpeted by Trump and the GOP congress. Don’t take our word for it; Indivisible has been featured on the Rachel Maddow Show multiple times, as well as in the New York Times and in pretty much every other major news outlet in the country.

We’re building together. We’re building a new organization every day - a rare opportunity to model what we want to see in the world. We’re deeply committed to equity and building a diverse and inclusive organization.

We’re looking for you. If you want to fight for the soul of American democracy, there’s no better place to be than Indivisible. We’re looking for more team members who are passionate about building an inclusive democracy and committed to getting results. It’s an exciting, fulfilling place if you’re someone who wants to fight fiercely for the progressive world we want to have.

Every one of us on the national team is here because we believe this movement is the best way to retake and build progressive power in this country. Does that ring true for you? If so, great - throw your hat in the ring to join our team. Let’s start #winning together. For more information about Indivisible’s organizational principles, click here.

Indivisible Project is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage and seek applications from women, people of color, including bilingual and bicultural individuals, as well as members of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender communities. Applicants shall not be discriminated against because of race, religion, sex, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, color, marital status, or medical condition. Reasonable accommodation will be made so that qualified disabled applicants may participate in the application process. Please advise in writing of support needs at the time of application.

Value Creation & Transformation - Deliver sustainable value through cost optimization, productivity, risk reduction, and innovation, collaborating with IT and the business to enable transformation and drive simplification and scalability.

Risk, Compliance & Responsibility - Proactively manage cyber, data, geopolitical, and supply risks while ensuring regulatory and policy compliance and embedding ESG, sustainability, and responsible sourcing into the IT category strategy.

As an ​​International Student Advisor at Passage, you will help expand our reach by engaging directly with prospective students across global markets. You will guide students from first inquiry through application, ensuring they understand program options, study pathways, financing opportunities, and visa processes. This role is ideal for someone with experience in international education advising, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for helping students navigate life-changing decisions.

Who we are

Our mission is bold but simple: by 2030, we aim to dismantle the barriers preventing brilliant minds from accessing the opportunities they deserve. Starting with financial barriers, we provide loans to international students and refugees so they can pursue higher education in Canada and unlock a world of possibilities.

Who you are

Mission-driven: You believe in the power of education to transform lives.
Student-centric: You listen deeply, advocate for students, and guide them confidently through complex processes.
Results-oriented: You work toward clear metrics and deliver consistent outcomes.
Industry-savvy: You understand Canadian programs, admissions timelines, visa requirements, and recruitment trends.
Operationally strong: You stay organized, follow through on every lead, and ensure nothing slips between the cracks.

Student recruitment and advising

  • Engage with prospective students through calls, messages, events, and webinars

  • Guide students through application steps, required documents, deadlines, and next-step decisions

  • Maintain a deep understanding of Passage’s programs, financing products, and admissions standards

Pipeline and performance management

  • Own and deliver on monthly and weekly recruitment and conversion targets

  • Track every lead and application through Passage’s CRM with accuracy and discipline

  • Identify bottlenecks and proactively move students toward submission and enrollment

  • Analyze conversion data to improve workflows and student guidance

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Partner closely with the admissions team to ensure clean, complete applications

What you bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in international student recruitment, advising, or counseling

  • Strong knowledge of Canadian admissions, program pathways, and visa processes

Skills

  • Outstanding communication and student engagement abilities

  • Strong advising, problem-solving, and expectation-setting skills

  • Experience working in CRMs and managing high-volume pipelines

  • Organized, reliable, and detail-focused

  • Ability to work across time zones and cultural contexts

Why join Passage

At Passage, we’re redefining global student mobility by combining financing, admissions, and career success into one seamless experience. You will join a fast-growing, mission-driven team that’s helping students access opportunities that change lives.

raw.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Payments
raw.excerpt: About UsCircle is building the world’s leading all-in-one platform for online communities.
raw.description:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading all-in-one platform for online communities. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 200 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Payments to own and drive product marketing for one of Circle’s most exciting, fastest-growing, and highest-impact product areas.

Circle customers already generate over $300M in annual GMV, and that number is accelerating rapidly. Payments is a critical surface area that directly impacts customer success, revenue growth, and the long-term scalability of community-powered businesses.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with our Head of Growth and Payments, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to bring new payments features, improvements, and monetization capabilities to market. You’ll report directly to the Head of Product Marketing and play a key role in shaping how Circle’s payments story is told internally and externally.

If you’re energized by complex product surfaces, love turning infrastructure into clear customer value, and want to work on a product area with real revenue impact, this role is for you.

What you'll be doing

Own messaging and positioning for Circle’s Payments surface area.Develop and evolve clear, differentiated messaging that explains how Circle enables customers to monetize, scale, and run sustainable businesses through payments.

Craft high-impact copy and product content.Write, edit, and oversee the creation of payments-related product content across the website, emails, launch assets, sales decks, and product collateral. Your focus will be on translating complex payments functionality into clear, compelling customer value.

Guide go-to-market strategy for payments features and improvements.Partner with Product, Growth, and Engineering to plan and execute launches for new payments capabilities, optimizations, and experiments. Ensure launches are well-coordinated, adoption-focused, and measurable.

Enable the go-to-market team.Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to create sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, FAQs, battlecards, and internal training that help teams confidently sell and support Circle’s payments capabilities.

Develop customer-facing enablement and education.Create external resources including product guides, FAQs, help content, and onboarding materials that help customers understand and fully leverage payments features to grow their businesses.

Collaborate cross-functionally to drive insight-led messaging.Partner with Product, Growth, Customer Success, and Data teams to gather customer insights, feedback, and performance data. Use these insights to continuously refine messaging, positioning, and launch strategies.

Support Circle’s broader product marketing strategy.Contribute to Circle’s overall messaging and positioning framework by ensuring payments narratives are consistent, differentiated, and aligned with our broader product vision and brand.

What you'll need to be successful

  • Strong alignment with our values. Find our values on our career page if you haven’t read up on them yet.
  • You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C1 / ILR Level 5.
  • 5+ years of product marketing experience, preferably within a high-growth, software company environment, with a strong emphasis on messaging, positioning, and copywriting.
  • A commitment to excellence and craft. We sweat the small details. We obsess over copy, clarity, and consistency. We hold a high bar for how our product and brand show up in the world, and we expect you to do the same.
  • Exceptional written communication skills. You are an excellent writer and editor. In a fully remote, async company, writing is one of your most important tools.
  • Proven ability to create high-impact messaging that resonates with diverse audiences and drives real outcomes, from product adoption to revenue growth.
  • Strong storytelling and simplification skills. You’re able to take complex product surfaces and translate them into clear, compelling narratives that customers immediately understand and value.
  • Experience crafting positioning frameworks and leading go-to-market strategies for new product launches, working cross-functionally from strategy through execution.
  • A deep understanding of customer personas and pain points, and a demonstrated ability to address them through thoughtful, customer-first messaging.
  • A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility end-to-end, from defining the problem to shipping the solution and measuring impact. You don’t wait to be told what to do, and you care deeply about the outcomes of your work.
  • A track record of effective cross-functional collaboration with Product, Growth, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver successful launches and campaigns.
  • A strong work ethic and comfort with high expectations. We’re a fast-growing, venture-backed company with ambitious plans. This role is high-impact and high-accountability, and it’s best suited for someone who thrives in that environment.

Bonus Points

  • You’re a growth marketer turned PMM (or have spent meaningful time in growth), and naturally think about messaging in, funnels, experimentation, and how positioning decisions drive real adoption, activation, and revenue impact.
  • You’ve worked on payments or monetization products and know how to bring pricing, checkout, subscriptions, or revenue workflows to market with clarity, trust, and a focus on durable business value.

$140,000 - $160,000 USD per year

The cash compensation range shown is a starting point. In addition to equity, benefits and perks, your cash compensation is subject to an annual review and increase on a once per year basis.

The fun stuff

  • Fully remote: work from anywhere in the world!
  • Autonomy and trust to do your job: we care about outcomes over everything else.
  • Paid time away: all employees are given 35 days of PTO annually. We also offer a paid sabbatical after 5 years.
  • Generous U.S. benchmarked compensation and startup equity no matter where you are in the world.*
  • Awesome medical coverage with 100% coverage for you and your family, or medical reimbursement options where applicable!*
  • Parental leave for parents expanding their family, or just starting one.
  • Home office stipend to help you get up and running.
  • Learning & development stipend to help you level up your professional skills.
  • Annual bonus potential for roles that don't already receive variable income or commission.
  • Company retreats: Twice a year, the Circle team gets together for a fully paid company retreat in incredible places around the world! We’ve had past retreats in Colombia, Portugal, and Mexico, with more planned on the horizon.
  • Check out our Careers page for more.

*Your role, location and unique circumstance may affect this.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

As a fully-remote international company, diversity is baked into our DNA. Here’s how our CEO, Sid Yadav, frames our hiring mission: “let’s find talent in underserved and under-represented corners of the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, change their life.” To achieve this hiring mission, we offer competitive U.S. benchmarked compensation no matter where someone’s located in the world, and we proactively seek candidates who expand representation of backgrounds, cultures and lived experiences in our teams.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Circle is an equal opportunity employer and as such, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

How We Use Candidate Data

At Circle, we are committed to protecting your personal information. As a job applicant, the personal data you provide to us is collected and processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in the EU and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). This notice outlines the types of personal information we collect, the purpose for collecting it, and your rights.

Information We Collect: We collect the following categories of personal information from job applicants:

  • Contact information (such as name, email address, phone number)
  • Employment history and qualifications
  • Education history
  • References and any other information you choose to share with us during the application process

Purpose of Collection: We collect this information for the following purposes:

  • To assess your qualifications and suitability for the position
  • To communicate with you during the recruitment process
  • To comply with legal and regulatory obligations

Your Rights Under GDPR and CCPA: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • The right to request access to the personal information we hold about you.
  • The right to request the deletion of your personal information, subject to certain legal exceptions.
  • The right to opt out of the sale of your personal information (Note: We do not sell personal information).

For more information about how we handle your personal data or to exercise your rights, please refer to our full Privacy Policy.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice.

Business Development Manager Wallonia & Brussels (FR/NL) @ Dexxter

📍 Remote from Wallonia with occasional travel to our offices in Ghent/ Mechelen

🗣️ French (Dutch is a strong plus)

🎯 Medior level

🚀 Start date: April 2026

About Dexxter

Dexxter was founded in 2021 by an accountant, an IT specialist and a marketer. Our mission? To make accounting easier and more affordable for sole traders. Today, over 20,000 entrepreneurs use our platform — often in collaboration with an accountant. Since 2024, Dexxter has been part of Teamleader, while continuing to operate as an independent team of 20 people from our office near Mechelen station.

About Teamleader

Teamleader is a Belgian SaaS scale-up and has been part of the Visma Group since 2022.
We help entrepreneurs work smarter with:

  • Teamleader Focus – CRM, project management & invoicing

  • Teamleader One – e-invoicing for sole traders

  • Acquisitions: Orbit (2019), Vectera (2022), Dexxter (2024)

Will you put Dexxter on the map in French-speaking Belgium?

Dexxter is a fast-growing Belgian accounting app for sole traders, with over 20,000 customers today.
Some manage their accounting fully independently, others work together with one of our 500 partner accountants.

Although Dexxter is fully available in French, most of our customers and partners are currently Dutch-speaking.
We’re looking for someone who wants to change that.

This is not a traditional sales role. This is pioneering work.

What you’ll do

  • Build strong relationships with accountants in Wallonia and Brussels, and demonstrate the value of Dexxter

  • Develop partnerships with relevant network and professional organisations

  • Act as the local face of Dexxter: at events, with partners, and online (LinkedIn)

  • Help shape the positioning, messaging and go-to-market approach for the French-speaking market

  • Work with a high level of autonomy, while collaborating closely with:

    • the business developers of other Teamleader products (Team Ecosystem)

    • Dexxter’s marketing and customer service teams

Requirements

We’re not looking for a “perfect CV” — we’re looking for the right mindset:

  • You speak fluent French (knowledge of Dutch is a strong plus)

  • You have experience in business development, partnerships or networking

  • You feel comfortable talking to accountants, entrepreneurs and partners

  • You can work independently, but know when alignment is needed

You get energy from building something on top of a solid foundation.
There are already a few hundred French-speaking customers and several partners — satisfied users who leave strong reviews.

What you can expect from us?

  • The energy of a startup combined with the structure of a scale-up

  • Plenty of room to grow, make an impact and develop yourself

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • 32 days of paid leave (full-time), on top of public holidays

  • Annual training budget tailored to your ambitions

  • Hybrid working model + budget for home office equipment

  • Meal vouchers

  • Strong focus on wellbeing and team spirit (feel free to check out our Instagram 😉)

raw.description:
A Unico é a maior rede de verificação de identidade do mundo e um pilar de confiança na sociedade digital. Com soluções baseadas em biometria facial, machine learning e camadas reforçadas de segurança, autenticamos com 100% de certeza quem está realizando uma transação e os riscos de identidade atrelados. Desta forma, nossas soluções combatem fraudes, protegem dados e promovem a confiança entre pessoas, empresas e governos, colaborando para a construção de um mundo mais seguro e menos burocrático.
Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras; impactamos sem rodeios; somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis; resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir; fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Ajudar as pessoas do time na evolução de suas carreiras através de 1:1, feedbacks contínuos, avaliações de desempenho, desenvolvimento de metas e construção de planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Liderar pessoas com diferentes níveis de maturidade e hard-skills;
  • Promover a geração de valor e impacto no negócio dentro do time, entendendo e traduzindo os requisitos do produto em requisitos funcionais para o time;
  • Engajar o time na resolução de problemas complexos dos sistemas de back-end/front-end/mobile mantidos pelo time;
  • Suportar o time na sustentação e desenvolvimento da melhoria contínua dos seus sistemas, promovendo evoluções arquiteturais aderentes às necessidades do negócio;
  • Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico de soluções, atuando como um embaixador técnico, capaz de fazer as perguntas certas, para que o time possa construir as soluções de software certas.

O que esperamos que você tenha:

  • Foco em gestão de pessoas,
  • Experiência passadas em liderança de times,
  • Conhecimento em metodologia ágil,
  • Conhecimento em gestão de backlogs,
  • Conhecimento em qualidade de testes (QA).

Conheça os benefícios de se tornar um Ser Unico

Benefício flexível: R$1.500,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias;
Auxílio home office: valor mensal de R$ 120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo;
PLR: elegível a Participação nos Lucros e Resultados conforme acordo sindical;
Benefício Educação: a Unico financia 100% dos estudos para 100% dos colaboradores através de cursos disponíveis na plataforma Unico Skill. Você pode escolher entre graduação, pós-graduação, MBAs, idiomas, cursos especializantes e mentorias;
Bem-estar: acesso à plataformas como Gympass e Totalpass;
Licença parental estendida: 180 dias para gestantes e cuidadores principais do processo de adoção e 60 dias para não gestantes e cuidados secundários do processo de adoção, com salário e benefícios pagos integralmente ao longo de todo o período.

Local de trabalho

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza o remoto, o nosso #tetounico. Isso significa que os Seres têm a opção de frequentar os escritórios caso queiram, e de acordo com as necessidades de cada área. Temos escritórios nas cidades de São Paulo e Londrina.

E mais…

Oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado de acordo com suas competências e interesses, com oportunidade de crescimento como especialista ou líder, incentivando o seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional através de ciclos de avaliação de performance semestrais (com feedback estruturado e plano de desenvolvimento individual);
Para completar a sua experiência, por aqui temos palestras, meetups, workshops, treinamentos, day off no aniversário, reunioff às quartas-feiras, festas e celebrações internas/externas, happy hour presencial quinzenal, grupos de afinidade e ginástica laboral.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.
Estamos construindo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e para nos apoiar em melhores práticas, criamos o formulário de Diversidade & Inclusão. Te convidamos a respondê-lo pra nos ajudar nesse processo, mas deixamos claro que você pode optar por não fazer isso sem impacto na sua avaliação. O compartilhamento desses dados não irá afetar o seu desempenho no processo seletivo e será usado somente para fins de criação de estratégias de inclusão.

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Unico?

Assista nosso manifesto;
Acompanhe nossas redes sociais: LinkedIn e Instagram

raw.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to inspire and engage people in lifelong health, one step at a time.

Job Overview:

Under the guidance of the Chief Care Delivery Operations Officer, the Senior Director of Clinical Operations & Practice is a strategic leadership role in Care Teams responsible for overseeing all aspects of Omada’s clinical operations (currently: CDCES, exercise specialists, on-call program, third party prescribing operations) including member outcomes & engagement, cost and employee engagement. This role will be the primary operating partner to the Clinical organization for strategically expanding clinical programming outlined in Omada’s 5 year program vision. This individual will lead cross-functional teams inside of and outside of their direct reporting line to optimize operations for all clinical conditions across Care Teams. This role will leverage technology and data insights to optimize clinical operations delivery. This role will lead continuous improvement of clinical operations.

Your Impact:

  • Develop & implement long-term, comprehensive clinical operations strategies (i.e. T1D, T2D, HTN, Hyperlipidemia, GLP1s, AOMs….) focused on member experience, clinical quality, team efficiency, and employee experience.
  • Cultivate a strong, cohesive clinical operations leadership team that effectively oversees day to day operations, ensures clinical safety & compliance, and collaborates seamlessly with cross functional Care Team leaders (i.e. Member Services, Health Coaching, MSK, Operational Excellence…).
  • Serves as the primary operating partner to the Clinical team for condition specific program development, translating long term clinical strategy (i.e. prescriber operations) into multi-year operating strategies. Leads all operational execution.
  • Establishes robust partnership with Care Teams Operational Innovation (CTOI) to ensure operational readiness for new product integration, product optimization, AI care team of the future implementation and ensures strong ‘voice of clinical operations’ representation within CTOI.
  • Leads operational excellence within clinical operations including continuous improvement strategies/projects, operating metrics review/improvement, and standardization where appropriate.

To be successful, you will need:

  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or clinical operations, with a strong emphasis on operational strategy and execution.
  • Required: active RN, RD or ARNP license
  • Demonstrated success in leading complex operational initiatives in dynamic environments.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and cultivate strong culture.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of performance improvement practice

To stand out:

  • Experience within the healthcare technology sector.
  • Virtual care delivery experience.
  • MBA or MHA
  • Advanced clinical practice degree
  • CDCES certification

Working conditions:

  • Remote-first environment.
  • Travel requirements may be up to 25%.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity Grants
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible vacation to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We actively cultivate trust through attentive listening and supporting one another. We respectfully provide and are open to receiving candid feedback.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.

raw.description:
Opening Hook: You've been hiding it in interviews. The early morning barn trips. The weekend shows. The fact that you know more about blanket denier counts than most people know about anything. At Schneiders, that's not your secret life -- it's your superpower.
Body:
We're Horse People. Hiring Horse People.
Schneiders Saddlery has served riders since 1948. We're not a venture-backed startup that discovered "equestrian is a market." We're the real deal -- 75 years of value-priced, quality horse supplies, built by horse people for horse people.
Now we need a Growth Manager who lives it.
Why Your Equestrian Background is REQUIRED:
Because you understand things a generic DTC marketer never will:
  • Why a horse owner agonizes over a $200 blanket purchase but drops $500 on vet bills without blinking
  • That "waterproof" and "water-resistant" aren't interchangeable (and your customers know the difference)
  • Why the hunter/jumper crowd and the barrel racing crowd need completely different messaging
  • That seasonal timing isn't about "Q4 holiday push" -- it's about clipping season, show season, turnout season
  • Why trust matters more than price in this community (bad tack = dangerous tack)
  • That the person buying isn't always the person riding (hello, horse mom buying for her daughter)
We're In It With You. That's our value. And you can't live it if you don't know the life.
But Wait -- You Also Need to BUILD with AI:
Here's where it gets specific. We don't just want an equestrian marketer. We want one who BUILDS with AI:
  • You've created automations using Zapier, Make, or similar platforms with AI integration
  • You've built custom apps, dashboards, or tools using AI assistance
  • You practice "vibe coding" -- using Claude or ChatGPT to build things daily
  • You've deployed agentic AI systems or AI-powered workflows in production
  • You have a hunger to automate everything and develop everyone around you
Automate Everything. Develop Everyone. That's our leadership principle.
What You'll Own (Full-Stack Growth):
  • Paid Acquisition: Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, influencer collabs with riders/trainers
  • Shopify Platform: Merchandising, UX, CRO, A/B testing (you know what "above the bit" means AND how to test a product page)
  • SEO Strategy: Educational content that converts (blanket weight guides, bit selection, boot fitting)
  • Amazon Execution: Marketplace growth, agency management
  • Analytics: CAC, LTV, cohorts, attribution (GA4, SQL)
  • AI Systems: Build automations that scale your output 10x
Your Equestrian Edge in Action:
  • Ad creative that speaks the language (not "horse equipment" -- "turnout blankets rated for 10-degree nights")
  • Landing pages that answer the questions riders actually ask
  • Influencer partnerships with authentic riders, not just anyone with followers
  • Product page optimization based on how equestrians actually shop
  • Seasonal campaigns timed to how horse owners actually buy
  • Content strategy built on genuine expertise, not keyword-stuffed generic copy
Compensation:
  • Base: $110K-140K
  • Bonus: 20-30% (tied to growth metrics you own)
  • Total: $132K-182K
  • Benefits: Health/dental/vision, 401(k) match, professional development, AI tool budget
  • Remote-friendly/hybrid (Chagrin Falls, OH headquarters)
Our Core Values:
  • We Own the Outcome: Your metrics, your responsibility, no finger-pointing
  • We're In It With You: We serve our community because we ARE our community
  • We Keep Growing: Always learning, always improving, mistakes are data
  • We're Built to Last: 75 years and counting -- we build for the long haul
You'll Succeed If You:
  • Are an active/former rider or horse owner (any discipline welcome)
  • Have 5-7 years DTC e-commerce/growth marketing experience
  • Have BUILT AI tools, automations, or apps (portfolio required)
  • Know Shopify hands-on, GA4/SQL fluently
  • Want ownership, autonomy, and real impact
  • Move fast: Actions Unlock Answers is how you operate
Career Path: Growth Manager -> Senior Growth Manager -> Director of Growth -> VP of Marketing
To Apply: Resume + cover letter addressing:
  1. Your equestrian background (discipline, years riding, current involvement)
  2. AI tools/automations you've BUILT (links, screenshots, descriptions)
  3. Growth marketing wins with real numbers
Timeline: Spring 2026 start | Offers February/March

CREATE MASSIVE IMPACT 🚀
